terminology.exclusive_meaning: P1-P6 describe what class of evaluation/intelligence product the system is allowed to claim; they never describe project schedule, software sprint, implementation wave or Episode Stage.

capability_phases.name: Observed Performance
capability_phases.purpose: Observed aircraft and mission-system engineering performance; no context attribution or intrinsic-capability claim.
capability_phases.frozen_extension_scope: Aircraft and mission-system observed-performance products, evidence and numeric longitudinal trend.

capability_phases.name: Context Attribution & Normalization
capability_phases.purpose: Attribute/normalize observed performance using frozen context/factor views.
capability_phases.frozen_extension_scope: Factor views, attribution/normalization, adjusted estimate and identifiability governance.

capability_phases.name: Intrinsic Capability / Aircraft Twin
capability_phases.purpose: Estimate intrinsic capability under governed as-of lifecycle/configuration semantics.
capability_phases.frozen_extension_scope: Reference-condition longitudinal estimate, capability model/surface, aircraft twin and model profile.

capability_phases.name: Human-Machine Assessment
capability_phases.purpose: Assess W↔P↔A↔M evidence and human-machine interaction.
capability_phases.frozen_extension_scope: Individual/human-machine qualification, competency diagnostics, evidence and instructor-review workflow.

capability_phases.name: Team / Mission / System Assessment
capability_phases.frozen_extension_scope: Team/package/mission objective assessment with composition-aware longitudinal analysis.

capability_phases.name: Prediction / Counterfactual / Closed Loop
capability_phases.purpose: Governed forecast/counterfactual products physically separated from facts.
capability_phases.frozen_extension_scope: Forecast/counterfactual/recommendation products separated from facts and requiring explicit assumptions/approval.

admission_order: P1 observed evidence is immutable input
P2 may consume but never overwrite P1
P3 may consume validated P2 and lifecycle/as-of data
P4 may consume C/W/P/A/J/M + metrics but does not alter facts
P5 aggregates multi-entity/team/mission evidence without copying team result to individuals
P6 consumes published history/models and remains separate from replay/facts
legacy_delivery_mapping_note: Legacy 1A-1G and metric 1C/1D/1E labels were historical implementation-wave labels. They are retired as current progress language and are mapped in TERMINOLOGY_REGISTRY/DEVELOPMENT_MILESTONE_REGISTRY.
